profile.headline: Sr. Graphic Software Engineer at Intel Corporation
profile.summary:
• Embedded system S/W design using C/C++ and assembly for OS device driver, firmware for popular CPU architectures such as ARM and X86

• Graphic S/W development - Linux Graphic 3D Rendering S/W Stack (User-Space 3D DRI driver -- OpenGL/ES Implementation) 

• Strong user mode and Kernel mode software debugging skill using various debugging methods – GDB, memory dumps and assembly level tracing

• Board development experience including Board schematic design, Layout follow up and PCB bring up

• Experience with standard Ethernet communication protocols – ARP, Ping, DHCP, TFTP, UDP and UDL 

• S/W tools – GDB, GNU tool chain, Eclipse Based IDE and JTAG emulators such as Lauterbach

positions.title: Sr. Graphic Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Primary owner of Intel User Space 3D Driver (OpenGL/ES backend) for Intel HD GPU that adds 
hardware-accelerated 3D rendering capability to X11 and WAYLAND environment (MESA) for Linux targeting automotive navigation and entertainment system 

- Currently working on enabling OpenGL ES 3.1 on MESA front-end and Intel user space 3D driver (DRI)

- Implemented new feature, “DMA_BUF_IMPORT” to enable “OES_EGL_image_external” extension in Intel 3D DRI Driver 

- Debugged and fixed critical issues on Kernel DRM driver related to incorrect ring buffer sequencing and frame-buffer flipping 

- Lead OpenGL ES 3.0 and 3.1 validation and benchmark – Experience with standard GL validation suites such as OGLconform, GTF and piglit and 3D benchmark suites such as Basemark and GLBench

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Post-Si Android OS Porting and bring-up on Intel smartphone and tablet platforms powered by Intel atom multi-core SoC such as Clovertrail (Lenovo K900) and Merrifield (Latest Dell Venue 7/8)

- Developed Board Support Package for Android OS during pre-Si stage

- Debugged and stabilized Linux Kernel code base during Si Power-On activity - Fixed bugs on kernel core part including power management and peripheral drivers such as RS232 and I2C

- Primary maintainer of official and experimental Android OS Builds during Power-on stage

positions.title: Staff System Applications Engineer
positions.description:
-	Responsible for low-level S/W design such as firmware and device driver for CPU and peripherals in Multi-core DSP that consists of two ARM11 cores and four StarCore DSP processors designed for the real-time video and audio format transcoding application

-	Designed and maintained BSP that contains CPU architecture-specific boot-up code, Board specific configurations and IO function libraries for RTOS such as VxWorks and ENEA OSE

-	Took part in SoC (Multi-core DSP) validation project as a lead S/W engineer; Verified CPU cores and IO blocks on emulated SoC design in Palladium system (Cadence) before manufacturing the actual silicon

-	Designed official BIST S/W that runs on 6 different processor cores in parallel and validates CPU cores – Code execution and data-handling and major on-chip IO blocks in the SoC silicon such as Multi-core BUS interconnects, ARM MMU, ARM and DSP’s Interrupt Controllers, DDR3 memory interface, DMA controller, TDM block, NAND flash controller, Ethernet Controller and Serial interfaces such as I2C and MDIO

-	Worked closely with customers to resolve issues related to the S/W packages such as Firmware or Device Driver delivered with SoC

positions.title: System Development Engineer
positions.description:
-	Designed analog and digital circuit for the hand-held ultrasound system

-	Designed and verified analog signal processing block that does pre-amp and modulation/demodulation of ultrasonic echo

-	Designed C++ test applications and a group of test scripts using LUA script language for debugging and verifying system’s operation

positions.title: System engineer, Student Researcher
positions.description:
-	Worked as a technical leader of the project team funded by Siemens USA and successfully developed and delivered small scale medical ultrasound scanners prototypes that inspired the company to start developing its commercial model, P10 handheld medical ultrasound imaging system
 
-	Designed system control block based on ARM processor (Intel Xscale), running embedded LINUX

-	Took full responsibility for whole circuit schematics, PCB design and hardware integration

-	Developed system control software and embedded LINUX device drivers for various peripherals

company.name: CMSR medical research group founded by Siemens Medical Solutions
